title: Orbis: The power of perspective
author: Povilas Dapkevicius
body: It is easy to get caught up in the noise of short-term events like politics. What we have learned over the past 30 years is that a long-term view often reveals things others miss, and potential where others see only risk. But it is a luxury few investors can afford. Watch this 4-minute video from our offshore partner Orbis to learn more.
